related_questions.question: Does Air France allow 24 hour cancellation?

text_blocks.snippet: Yes, Air France generally offers a 24-hour cancellation policy for flights booked on their website (www.airfrance.us) for flights to or from the USA. This policy allows passengers to cancel their booking, including any paid options, within 24 hours of purchase for a full refund, provided the departure date is at least seven days away, according to Air France.
snippet_highlighted_words: Yes, Air France generally offers a 24-hour cancellation policy for flights booked on their website (www.airfrance.us) for flights to or from the USA

list.title: Applicability:
list.snippet: This 24-hour cancellation policy applies to flights booked on the Air France website to or from the USA, according to Air France.

list.title: Timeframe:
list.snippet: The cancellation must be requested within 24 hours of booking the flight.

list.title: Departure Date:
list.snippet: The departure date for the outbound flight must be at least 7 days after the booking date for the 24-hour cancellation policy to apply.

list.title: Refunds:
list.snippet: Passengers are eligible for a full refund of the ticket price and any paid options within this timeframe, according to Air France.

list.title: How to Request:
list.snippet: To request a refund within 24 hours, passengers can visit the "My Bookings" or "Contact us" section on the Air France website.

list.title: Refund Processing:
list.snippet: Air France will process refunds within seven business days for credit card purchases and within twenty calendar days for debit cards, cash, or check purchases, according to Air France.
